scope: Additive current-source follow-up for Meteor Golem and required Meteormite; records a post-buff child-data contradiction without activating an incomplete lifecycle.
game_version: Official 2025/2026 notes and public tables consulted on 2026-09-20.

sources.title: Cosmic Rock Medal Event!
sources.limitations: Confirms closest-target throwing, nearby-target-or-merge child choice and Wall jumping for the temporary precursor; no distances, tick ordering, flight, collision, merge clock or permanent-version guarantee.

sources.title: Meteormite
sources.limitations: Displays L1-L3 220/240/260 DPS and 7,500/8,500/9,500 HP, plus 1.5-second/0.8-tile metadata. Its parent values are the pre-January 2026 balance values, while Supercell confirms a later July buff; it is stale and none of its child numbers are imported as current.

sources.title: Meteor Golem
sources.limitations: Corroborates current parent L1-L3 values, 1-second cadence and five-tile range, but supplies no current Meteormite table or split/merge geometry.

known_uncertainties: No current build-pinned Meteormite table is available after the official July 2026 buff.
No consulted source defines split trigger/health partition, throw trajectory/landing, merge range/priority/delay, invulnerability duration, collision geometry or same-tick ordering.
conclusion: Meteor Golem L1-L3 and required Meteormite remain data-only. The 20 September audit confirms the available child table is stale after official balances and leaves the unique split/throw/merge behavior intentionally disabled.
